dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a concave spline curve from the dorsal ridge to the apex, forming a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point has a small pixel radius and is classified as acute-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin is a convex slope at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a prominent and steeply rounded melon boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The visible rostrum is extremely short and blunt with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: The melon slope transitions into the rostrum at a shallow obtuse angle of approximately 165 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, light-colored linear striations are visible on the mid-lateral flank surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct high-contrast pigmentation with a dark dorsal field and a bright white ventral patch; a dark pigment band extends from the eye toward the pectoral fin.
